meta.title: Triptic user guide
meta.desc: From uploading bookings to live co-editing with friends, finding travel companions and exporting a beautiful PDF itinerary — a start-to-finish guide to Triptic.

hero.title: How to use Triptic
hero.lead: Build an itinerary from a single booking document, edit it with friends from one link, and print it as a beautiful PDF. Eight steps.

start.title: Get started
start.lead: Sign in and tap 'Create new trip'. Pick a city and dates and your itinerary screen is ready.
start.p1: Sign in quickly with a Google or Kakao account.
start.p2: Search the city on the map and pick dates in the calendar.
start.p3: You can also open the 'sample trip' before signing in (changes aren't saved).

docs.title: Upload your bookings
docs.lead: Upload flight e-tickets and hotel vouchers and AI fills your itinerary in for you.
docs.p1: PDFs, photos and screenshots all work.
docs.p2: Outbound/return flights and hotel check-in/out with address are filled in automatically.
docs.p3: Review everything in a confirmation window before it's applied, and fix anything that's off.

plan.title: Add places and plan your route
plan.lead: Search and add the places you want to visit — pins appear on the map and travel times between places are calculated.
plan.p1: Drag to reorder and the route and travel times update instantly.
plan.p2: Set breakfast, lunch and dinner spots under 'Meals of the day' and they join the itinerary with a visit time.
plan.p3: Get AI suggestions for what to visit next, and leave notes and times on each place.

share.title: Edit live with friends via a link
share.lead: Create a share link and send it in a messenger — as soon as your friend signs in, you're editing the same itinerary together.
share.p1: One link to invite — no setup to explain.
share.p2: Once signed in, they join as an editing member right away.
share.p3: Everyone's changes show up for everyone in real time.

companion.title: Find a travel companion
companion.lead: Find people heading to the same city on the same dates and travel together.
companion.p1: Post what age range, gender and tags you prefer, then accept applicants to confirm the match.
companion.p2: Posts that fit your next trip's city and dates are shown first with a match rate.
companion.p3: Once confirmed you get a chat room and expense splitting. Companions are for members only.

community.title: Share stories in the community
community.lead: Share travel stories, questions, tips and food finds on city boards and the free board.
community.p1: Attach your itinerary and turn on 'Allow copying' so others can take it as their own trip.
community.p2: Like, save, comment and reply — and get notified when people react to your posts.
community.p3: Use the writing guide to make your first post easily.

pdf.title: Export to PDF
pdf.lead: Turn your finished itinerary into a beautiful PDF you can print and carry. Tap 'Full itinerary PDF' in the share sheet on the itinerary screen — that's it! On desktop you can also use the 'Save trip as PDF' card next to the itinerary.
pdf.p1: Cover: city photo, travel mates, city flow by day, flight and hotel summary
pdf.p2: One page per day: route map + timeline + transit mode and time between places
pdf.p3: A notes area at the bottom of each page, a pre-departure checklist and an empty expense log
pdf.p4: Available in Korean, English, Japanese and Traditional Chinese
pdf.galleryHint: A real PDF exported from the 4-day Tokyo sample trip.
pdf.pages: Cover · daily map & timeline · notes · checklist · expense log

before.title: Before and during the trip
before.lead: Everything you need from before departure to the day you return, in one place.
before.p1: Get reminders 7 days, 1 day and on the day of departure, plus travel alerts for your destination.
before.p2: Tick off what to pack on the pre-departure checklist.
before.p3: Log daily expenses, and check the weather, live airport boards and parking status.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Can I use it without signing in?
faq.a1: You can try the sample trip and search flights, hotels and activities without signing in. Saving your trips and using the community or companions needs a sign-in.
faq.q2: What if my friend hasn't signed in?
faq.a2: They'll see a sign-in window when they open the share link and join the same itinerary right after signing in.
faq.q3: What language is the PDF in?
faq.a3: The language you've chosen in the app (Korean, English, Japanese or Traditional Chinese).

cta.title: Ready to start your trip?
cta.body: One booking document is all you need.
